pre_command:
osascript -e 'tell application "Calendar"
try
set baseDate to current date
set year of baseDate to 2025
set month of baseDate to October
set day of baseDate to 31
set hours of baseDate to 0
set minutes of baseDate to 0
set seconds of baseDate to 0
set targetDate to baseDate
set nextDay to targetDate + (1 * days)
repeat with currentCalendar in calendars
set eventsOnDate to (every event of currentCalendar whose start date ≥ targetDate and start date < nextDay)
repeat with currentEvent in eventsOnDate
set eventSummary to summary of currentEvent
if eventSummary is "Final Project Kickoff" then
delete currentEvent
end if
end repeat
end repeat
set newStartDate to current date
set year of newStartDate to 2025
set month of newStartDate to October
set day of newStartDate to 31
set hours of newStartDate to 9
set minutes of newStartDate to 0
set seconds of newStartDate to 0
set newEndDate to newStartDate + (1 * hours)
set firstCalendar to first calendar
make new event at end of firstCalendar with properties {summary:"Project Kickoff", start date:newStartDate, end date:newEndDate}
return true
on error
return false
end try
end tell'
instruction: Modify the event titled 'Project Kickoff' (which was initially set for October 31, 2025, at 9:00 AM for 1 hour) by changing its title to 'Final Project Kickoff' and moving its start time to 10:00 AM on the same date, but make it 1 hour longer.
evaluator:
osascript -e 'tell application "System Events"
if not (exists process "Calendar") then
return false
end if
end tell
tell application "Calendar"
try
set baseDate to (current date)
set year of baseDate to 2025
set month of baseDate to October
set day of baseDate to 31
set hours of baseDate to 0
set minutes of baseDate to 0
set seconds of baseDate to 0
set targetDate to baseDate
set nextDay to targetDate + (1 * days)
set foundNewEvent to false
set oldEventGone to true
repeat with currentCalendar in calendars
try
set eventsOnDate to (every event of currentCalendar whose start date ≥ targetDate and start date < nextDay)
repeat with currentEvent in eventsOnDate
try
set eventSummary to summary of currentEvent
set eventStartDate to start date of currentEvent
set eventEndDate to end date of currentEvent
set startTime to time of eventStartDate
set endTime to time of eventEndDate
set startHours to startTime div hours
set startMinutes to (startTime mod hours) div minutes
set endHours to endTime div hours
set endMinutes to (endTime mod hours) div minutes
if eventSummary is "Final Project Kickoff" and startHours is 10 and startMinutes is 0 and endHours is 12 and endMinutes is 0 then
set foundNewEvent to true
end if
if eventSummary is "Project Kickoff" and startHours is 9 and startMinutes is 0 then
set oldEventGone to false
end if
on error
end try
end repeat
on error
end try
end repeat
return (foundNewEvent and oldEventGone)
on error
return false
end try
end tell'
